params.name: aef-id
params.description: String identifying the API exposing function.

params.name: api-invoker-id
params.description: String identifying the API invoker which invoked the service API.

params.name: time-range-start
params.description: Start time of the invocation time range.

params.name: time-range-end
params.description: End time of the invocation time range.

params.name: api-name
params.description: Contains the API name set to the value of the "<apiName>" placeholder of the API URI as defined in clause 5.2.4 of 3GPP TS 29.122 [14].

params.name: api-version
params.description: Version of the API which was invoked.

params.name: operation
params.description: Operation that was invoked on the API.

params.name: result
params.description: Result or output of the invocation.

params.name: resource-name
params.description: Name of the specific resource invoked.

params.name: src-interface
params.description: Interface description of the API invoker.

params.name: dest-interface
params.description: Interface description of the API invoked.

params.name: supported-features
params.description: To filter irrelevant responses related to unsupported features

params.name: net-slice-info
params.description: Contains the identifier(s) of the network slice(s) within which the API shall be available.

items.docs: Query and retrieve service API invocation logs stored on the CAPIF core function.
